page.notes: The right-hand part of the page is cut off, so several entries end mid-word or lack their page numbers. Some words are doubtful: "ftatu horæ" may read "statu horæ"; "Synagoga sanctitas" and "venatio" are read as printed. Ornament at the foot is a fleuron, not transcribed. The first letters "T" and "V" and "I" are large decorative initials. Blue marks are printed page-reference links in the scan. Scan shows the page cut off at the lower and left side; the lower part has only the ornament and a faint watermark "Digitized by Google" (not transcribed). The word "NIS." at left is the tail of a heading cut off by the edge; the "Synedrium majus" line is set in italics with mixed spacing; "Orstius" is read as "Orftius" with doubt.
